nodes.label: Project Instructions (CLAUDE.md)
nodes.description: Root project instructions for Claude Code. Defines monorepo shape: back/ (Laravel 12), front/ (Vue 3), ingestion_service/ (Python), script_datos.py. Commands for backend, frontend, Docker, and ingestion. Architecture: routes → controllers → services → models → observers → events → broadcast + mail. Two ingestion paths: legacy POST /api/sensors/{sensor}/readings (API key) and raw-first POST /api/ingestion/events (token). Auth: Sanctum tokens, IoT API key, admin middleware. Rate limits: api-read 120/min, api-write 60/min, auth-login 5/min. Known gaps: no browser test suite, incomplete alert resolution/device status propagation, SMTP credentials in seeder.
nodes.rationale: The authoritative project overview for Claude Code agents. Defines the monorepo structure, all build/test commands, the two ingestion paths, auth mechanisms, and known gaps that constrain implementation.
